name: container-tools
description: Runs Bash, Read, Write, Edit and NotebookEdit inside a Docker container (Engine API over the socket) and removes every other host-facing tool

container.title: Container
container.description: Name or id of the container the tools run in (env CONTAINER_TOOLS_CONTAINER)

image.title: Image
image.description: Create the container from this image when it does not exist; empty: never create (env CONTAINER_TOOLS_IMAGE)

workdir.title: Working directory
workdir.description: Working directory inside the container; empty: the container's own (env CONTAINER_TOOLS_WORKDIR)

network.title: Network
network.description: NetworkMode for a container this plugin creates; empty: docker's default (env CONTAINER_TOOLS_NETWORK)

mounts.title: Mounts
mounts.description: Comma-separated binds host:container[:ro] for a container this plugin creates (env CONTAINER_TOOLS_MOUNTS)

user.title: User
user.description: User the tools run as in the container; empty: the container's (env CONTAINER_TOOLS_USER)

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: session: follow the session's permission rules and mode; allow: run every call the rules do not deny (env CONTAINER_TOOLS_PERMISSIONS)

extraTools.title: Extra tools
extraTools.description: Comma-separated tool names to keep beside the default set, e.g. WebFetch (env CONTAINER_TOOLS_EXTRA_TOOLS)

tmpdir.title: Scratch directory
tmpdir.description: Directory in the container for the plugin's run files; must not be a tmpfs mount (env CONTAINER_TOOLS_TMPDIR)

startAttempts.title: Start attempts
startAttempts.description: How many times to try bringing the container up before the tool call fails (env CONTAINER_TOOLS_START_ATTEMPTS)
